# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v2 c13 P38](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0038), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v3 c8 P18](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0018), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette is described as tidy, practical, and unadorned, with a plump hand. On her wedding day, she was arrayed in white satin, tulle, lace, roses, orange blossoms, and an abundance of diamonds.

_Sources: [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c41 P9](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0009)_

## Personality

Odette is steady, composed, sensible, and pragmatic. She approaches her studies and responsibilities with diligent composure, avoiding sentimentality and romance in her writing and life. Practical and steady, she holds firm, matter-of-fact views on discipline and work.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c31 P30](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0030), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## History

Odette attended Brierley school alongside Nell Harcourt and Isolde Pembroke, where she joined the local tale-writing society and wrote sensible, unromantic stories. She prepared for the Entrance exam, passed with steady composure, and attended Regent's Academy, earning top marks in domestic science. Upon graduating, she took a teaching position in Stonebridge, where she maintained order strictly and earned a place on the Inspector's Honor Roll. She later became a member of the Brierley Village Improvement Society and briefly took over teaching at Brierley school. During a winter holiday, she conveyed a proposal of marriage on behalf of her brother Barney to Nell Harcourt, which Nell refused. Odette subsequently left Brierley to teach on western prairies. Returning from the West, she married Mr. Inglis, a wealthy mining millionaire from Winnipeg, in a lavish Brierley ceremony.

_Sources: [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c32 P18](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0018), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c4 P0](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0000), [v2 c4 P2](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0002), [v2 c6 P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 c28 P3](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0003), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003), [v3 c39 P18](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0018), [v3 c39 P20](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0020), [v3 c41 P9](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0009)_

> Now, she’s completely prepared.
